reading.title: The Impact of Artificial Intelligence on Education
reading.passage: Artificial intelligence is transforming the education sector by personalizing learning experiences for students. AI-powered tutoring systems can adapt to individual learning paces, identifying knowledge gaps and providing targeted feedback. Teachers can use AI tools to automate administrative tasks, allowing them to focus more on student engagement and critical thinking development. However, concerns about data privacy and the potential reduction of human interaction in education remain significant challenges that institutions must address carefully.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is one benefit of AI in education?
options: It eliminates the need for teachers
It personalizes learning experiences for students
It reduces the cost of textbooks
questions.explanation: 지문에서 'AI-powered tutoring systems can adapt to individual learning paces'라고 명시되어 있으며, AI가 학생들을 위해 개인화된 학습 경험을 제공한다고 설명합니다.

questions.q: What concern is mentioned about AI in education?
options: It works only for advanced students
Data privacy and reduction of human interaction
questions.explanation: 지문의 마지막 문장에서 'concerns about data privacy and the potential reduction of human interaction in education remain significant challenges'라고 명확히 언급되어 있습니다.

questions.q: How can teachers benefit from AI tools according to the passage?
options: They can automate administrative tasks and focus on engagement
questions.explanation: 지문에서 'Teachers can use AI tools to automate administrative tasks, allowing them to focus more on student engagement'라고 설명합니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement: 'Remote work is more productive than working in an office.' Provide specific reasons and examples to support your position.

structure.intro: 도입부에서는 찬성 또는 반대 입장을 명확히 제시하고, 주요 이유 2-3개를 간단히 언급하세요. (2-3문장)
structure.body1: 첫 번째 이유를 상세히 설명하고 구체적인 예시를 제시하세요. 예: 몰입도 증가, 통근 시간 감소 등 (4-5문장)
structure.body2: 두 번째 이유를 설명하고 반박 가능한 주장도 포함하세요. 예: 팀 협력, 소통의 어려움 등 (4-5문장)
structure.conclusion: 결론에서는 입장을 재확인하고 전체 논의를 종합하세요. (2-3문장)

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer to study alone. Others prefer to study in groups. Which do you prefer and why?
useful_expressions: In my opinion, I prefer to study alone because
One reason is that studying alone helps me concentrate better
Another advantage is that I can work at my own pace
However, I also recognize that group study has benefits
To sum up, I believe that
sample_points: 집중력 향상: 혼자 공부할 때는 방해 요소가 적어 더 깊이 있는 학습이 가능합니다. 특히 복잡한 주제를 공부할 때 자신의 속도에 맞춰 진행할 수 있습니다.
자유로운 시간 관리: 혼자 공부하면 자신의 일정에 맞춰 유연하게 공부 계획을 세울 수 있으며, 다른 사람을 기다릴 필요가 없습니다.

listening.title: Campus Library Services
listening.script: Student: Excuse me, I'm looking for information about the library's new study rooms. Librarian: Of course! We recently opened five new private study rooms on the third floor. They're equipped with computers, whiteboards, and high-speed internet. Each room can accommodate up to four students. Student: That sounds great! How do I reserve one? Librarian: You can reserve them online through our library website or come to the front desk. Reservations can be made up to two weeks in advance, and each session is limited to three hours. Student: What about the cost? Librarian: It's completely free for all registered students. We also have group study areas on the second floor if you prefer a more open environment. Student: Perfect! Thank you for the information.

questions.q: Where are the new study rooms located?
questions.explanation: 사서가 'We recently opened five new private study rooms on the third floor'라고 명시하였습니다.

questions.q: How far in advance can students make reservations?
questions.explanation: 대화에서 'Reservations can be made up to two weeks in advance'라고 언급되었습니다.

questions.q: What is the cost of using the private study rooms?
options: It is free for registered students
questions.explanation: 사서가 'It's completely free for all registered students'라고 명확하게 답변했습니다.
